title: Animate-oo
description: Not a game — a proper little 3D animation studio. Build characters from eight skeletons, cover them in fur, colours and patterns, give them moves on a timeline, set up camera shots and lighting, then film the whole thing and keep the video.

title: Time Freeze
description: Watch half a second of a disaster — then time stops dead! Move things about while it's frozen, start the clock again, and hope you've fixed it. 16 scenes: bin the crisps, catch a waiter's plates, keep Granny out of the puddle, and swap the groom.

title: My Library
description: A real bookshelf with 14 real books — Alice, Oz, The Jungle Book, Anne of Green Gables and more. Proper page-turning, your place is saved, and every word works with no internet at all.

title: Pong
description: The classic. First to 5 wins. You vs. the machine.

title: Head Chef
description: Cook tasty dishes for a hungry panda — every dish you cook unlocks a new, harder recipe!

title: Pixel Paint
description: Colour by number! 500+ pictures in 14 categories, draw your own, save designs, or pixelify a selfie.

title: Bristol Fashion
description: Design fabulous looks — hair, makeup, outfits — and fill your wardrobe.

title: Mystery Binoculars
description: AR safari! Search your room for hiding animals and tap them before they bolt.

title: Worms
description: Slither, eat, grow. Become the biggest worm in the mud.

title: DJ Panel
description: Drop beats and jam over rock, jazz and pop grooves. Airhorn included.

title: My World
description: Explore a cute 3D world — play park, mall, library, houses, a beach you can paddle at, and a zoo where you can go right in the cages with the lions, tigers and monkeys!

title: Super Pac Man
description: Pac-Man with a twist: powerups, fire hazards, and role reversal — become the ghost!

title: Mini Life
description: You're 1cm tall! Jump and fly around a giant, super-detailed kitchen.

title: Football Pens
description: Win the World Cup one penalty shootout at a time. Pick your nation and aim!

title: Growing Gardens
description: Design a 3D garden block by block — plant, water and watch it grow over the days.

title: Speed Tables
description: Times tables sprint! Score as many 12×12 answers as you can in 60 seconds.

title: Alive Me
description: AR binoculars! Hold your aim on a table or wall and watch it sprout 3D eyes and tentacles that wobble, blink and come alive.

title: Germ Racers
description: Top-down racing through the gut! Pick a germ, dodge the immune system, and burst out the far end first.

title: Water Maze
description: Tip a 3D wooden maze to pour water to a thirsty frog! Tilt your phone, join up the blobs, and dodge the toxic goo.

title: I Ate an Author
description: A creative studio — write stories, draw comics, design your own fonts, paint, and save it all to your gallery.

title: Growing, Chewing, Pigs
description: Plant, water and grow fruit and veg through day and night, then hand-feed it to your hungry pig. Chomp chomp!

title: ASMR
description: Sensory play in 3D! Squish slime, slide kinetic sand, crack wax, pop a poppet, crunch frozen flowers, snap magnets, prod a jelly and clack a tiny keyboard.

title: Tap 'em all
description: Tap every square before 3 seconds run out — each level adds one more. Tricky mode spins the screen, extreme mode makes them scurry!

title: Decorate
description: Design your own fashion! Pick a t-shirt, hoodie, skirt, shorts or headband, colour it, cover it in stickers, and see it worn.

title: Fruit Match
description: Drop cute fruits and match pairs to grow them — blueberry to watermelon! Make two watermelons touch to win. No rush!

title: Exports
description: Think up a secret password, then type it fast when the laser Exports attack! Every export you survive unlocks one of the tablet's secrets.

title: Jump
description: A fire-breathing dragon blocks your path! Jump its fireballs — dodge 10 and it's slain. Every level gets harder.

title: Lego Smash!
description: A bit like Minecraft! Every colour of brick, every piece — build anything in 3D, walk inside your creation, then SMASH it.

title: Make a Monster!
description: Mix and match eyes, fangs, noses, long wiggly legs and stripey socks to build your own silly monster — then save a picture of it!

title: Kiddo Wordo
description: Pick from 22 languages — Thai, Spanish, Japanese, Welsh, Somali, Korean and more. Tap words to hear them, then beat quiz lessons that get harder as you go!

title: Sharpeners
description: Pure satisfaction: feed pencils into a giant sharpener, tap the end, and watch the shavings coil out. No winning, just sharpening.

title: Polly Heedrun
description: Spin a 3D die with a drag, then tap its faces in order — 1, 2, 3… Correct taps buy you time! Levels climb from D6 to D20, with dots or numbers.

title: Play Paint
description: Loop around the field to paint it in — but everyone's a unicorn or a pig! Unicorns paint rainbow, pigs paint pink, and anyone who runs over your wet trail pops.

title: Chomped
description: You're a hole in the rainforest floor! Swallow leaves, frogs, monkeys and whole giant trees to grow bigger and bigger. Six holes to pick from, and rival holes want the forest too.

title: My Room
description: An empty room and a box of stuff! Tap the box, something pops out — a bed, a toilet, a teddy — and you put it where it goes. Keep going until the box is empty and your room is finished.

title: The Cinema
description: Basically a telly, and every show on it is made up! Catch up on the gossip in All The Friends, watch Super Snail save the day, guess along with Draw That Thing!, see aliens take over the universe, and wince at Glide or Die.

title: Studio Music
description: Press record, say anything, and it turns your voice into a song! Roll RANDOM for a whole new sound, press OK to keep it in your gallery of up to 100, and drag one to the bin to delete it.

title: Kawaii Creator
description: Loads of kawaii animals — pig, cat, axolotl, octopus, sloth, bunny, unicorn and a person. Tap one and it teaches you to draw it step by step, then snap a photo and keep it in that animal's button.

title: What Bot
description: Like a messaging app, but there's one friend to talk to and they're an A.I. Name them, draw both your pictures, and chat away — your chat is saved, and they never stop reminding you they're not real.

title: Mushroom City
description: A glowing 3D city where every house is a mushroom and the people are covered in them! Wander about, step inside the homes, and chat to the mushroom folk — they come over to talk to you.

title: Where's that Riddle?
description: Pick easy, medium or hard, then type your answer to riddle after riddle. Close counts — but get it wrong and you try again, because it NEVER tells you the answer!

title: Tidy Up!
description: There is a REALLY messy room! Drag every toy, bit of rubbish, pencil and drill into the right bag — Toys, Bin or Tools — in 20 seconds. 10 levels, more hard each level. GO!

title: Trampoline!
description: Trampoline is where people NEVER belong! Pull them down, let go, and sling-shot them all into the sky before time runs out — every launch buys you extra seconds.

title: Interior Designer
description: Every house on the street is empty! Go inside, paint each room's walls and floors, and fill them with beds, baths, sofas, fridges, plants and more.

title: Scrambled Eggs
description: Circular breakout in a frying pan! Slide your spatula around the rim, crack the eggshell, and get the ball rattling inside to scramble the whole egg.

title: Babysitter
description: Babies are crawling all over the baby-proofed house! Pick up a crying one, fetch the milk or teddy it wants, and earn hearts — 5 hearts brings a new baby. Can you get all 10 happy at once?

title: Sof 'em all
description: Nobody's napping! Pick a beanbag colour, drag every person onto it and tap them so they nod off — the whole row asleep before 10 seconds run out.

title: When I Grow Up
description: What do you want to be? Do work experience in ten jobs — prime minister, security guard, shopkeeper, astronaut, artist, guitarist, pianist, drummer, singer, dancer — and win by getting employed!

title: DIY
description: Two bowls: infinite bricks and blobby cement. Smear cement on a brick to stack another on top — dry bricks slide off! Build whatever you like, save it, and keep going from the gallery.

title: Locked
description: Locked in an escape room! Hunt for hidden keys, count clues to crack codes, press colour buttons in order and flip the lights off to find glowing numbers. 2 rooms per level, 20 levels — the first 5 against a 5-minute clock!

title: Stuck At The Store
description: Locked in the boutique 'till morning! Your only hope: dress every mannequin in cute kawaii tops, frilly shorts, skirts and shoes — once they're all dressed, you're released!
